updates.problem: A benchmark gold label can be authoritative for retrieval relevance while remaining silent about typed structural equivalence and target-transfer validity.
updates.target: Maintain separate evaluator identities for RETRIEVAL_RELEVANCE, STRUCTURAL_WITNESS_VALIDITY and TRANSFER_VALIDITY; build structural witness annotation/probe packets without borrowing relevance authority.
updates.falsifier: If a benchmark definition and independent audit establish that one label necessarily and reliably entails the exact registered structural and transfer claims, allow a narrowly scoped label-collapse rule for that benchmark only.

updates.problem: Dataset names, viewers and floating branches can change or fail independently of the benchmark artifacts, creating silent corpus drift or substitution risk.
updates.target: Require immutable revision/content identity and preserve viewer/transport failures separately from scientific benchmark state.
updates.native_residual: The Round-016 frozen IsoSci reference was wrong and was detected only after a source-identity audit; the mistake is preserved by erratum.
updates.falsifier: If measured corpus versions/viewers are demonstrably immutable and transport identity never affects benchmark conclusions, simplify this contract while preserving content hashes.

updates.problem: Round-016 has benchmark semantics and executable evaluators but no measured real MIR route performance.
updates.target: Acquire exact pinned MIR test bytes, freeze hidden query/evaluator packets, then compare lexical, embedding, domain-stripped relational and graph/structural routes under matched contracts.
updates.falsifier: If lexical+embedding matches richer routes on valid-witness recall, near-miss rejection and cost, preserve the null and keep richer structural routes optional.

updates.problem: IsoSci can test structural reasoning versus domain-knowledge retrieval, but the Round-016 frozen dataset reference was wrong and the current observed dataset is gated.
updates.target: After exact gated access and immutable file/split identity are established, freeze a corrected IsoSci packet before execution and keep its labels separate from MIR retrieval relevance.
updates.blocker: current exact immutable dataset-file identity and accessible bytes not established
updates.falsifier: If IsoSci cannot be obtained reproducibly or its isomorphism labels do not support the intended attribution test, do not use it as authority; substitute another pinned structural benchmark.
